name: Средние обломки — клиновидный остаток
subject: ONE destructible natural gray rock resource asset, angular stepped fused voxel geology, warm-gray primary stone with a few pale coarse mineral patches, dark-gray wide fracture seams and restrained FLAT olive moss color patches attached to stone surfaces (no growing plants). Large Minecraft-style cubic masses with chunky material pixels, no tiny rubble confetti, smooth beveled stone or photoreal texture. No soil, ground, grass, pedestal or landscape. This is ONE variant, not a family gallery or destruction sequence. All five copies show the same arrangement of main masses, cracks and separate fragments. Third destruction-stage MEDIUM remnant. One squat triangular stepped wedge-shaped chunk with a wide uneven fresh fracture plane, two modest neighboring broken blocks at bottom. Low simple mass, smaller/slimmer than second-stage intact core; no tall pinnacle.
caption: Один вариант соответствующей стадии разрушения: пять ракурсов без земли, ландшафта и подписи.
prompt_override: Edit this five-view reference sheet. Keep the warm gray stone palette, pale mineral color patches, restrained olive patches, large Minecraft voxel style, and pure white background. REBUILD the entire asset as a convincingly DESTROYED much lower remnant. Every visible geometric voxel must be very large; the maximum number of stacked cubes is strict. A broken TRIANGULAR WEDGE: just ONE squat sloping angular stone wedge, maximum FIVE coarse voxel steps high, about eight wide, four deep, and TWO loose chips separate from it. Strongly diagonal stepped top edge; no vertical spire or mountain-like cluster. Produce exactly five separate complete depictions of this SAME arrangement: front and back orthographic on upper row, left and right profiles and one isometric game view on lower row. Match the same fragment geometry and their fixed relative arrangement across all five views. No captions, labels, annotations, arrows, ground, soil, landscape, pedestal, contact shadows, ambient occlusion or cast shadows. Flat bright unlit colors; mild material tones only. Keep generous white margins. This is one asset variant, not a gallery of different rocks.
